title: SQL Snippet Practice Entry
question:
Find the page named "Data Analytics Study Dashboard" and add a new SQL column to the "Query Snippets" section.
**Task Requirements:** 1. In the "Query Snippets" section, create (or locate) a column dedicated
   to the SQL language. This column must appear between the existing Python
   and R columns within the same column list.

2. At the top of the SQL column, add a bold paragraph that contains exactly
   the text SQL.

3. Under the header paragraph, add three code-block blocks configured with
   language set to sql:
   a. Basic SELECT query - Caption must be Basic SELECT query and the code
   content must be exactly:
   ```sql
   SELECT customer_id, order_total
   FROM orders
   WHERE order_total > 100;
   ```
   b. Grouped revenue summary - Caption must be Grouped revenue summary and
   the code content must be exactly:
   ```sql
   SELECT region, SUM(order_total) AS revenue
   FROM orders
   GROUP BY region;
   ```
   c. Join customers to orders - Caption must be Join customers to orders
   and the code content must be exactly:
   ```sql
   SELECT customers.name, orders.order_total
   FROM customers
   JOIN orders ON customers.id = orders.customer_id;
   ```
